rationale: This is a mechanical SUMRANK blend of two already-evaluated signals (Innovation Per-Share Conversion and Innovation Dilution-Adjusted Conversion) sharing the identical R&D gate, so it is a cosmetic averaging of archived variants rather than a new economic mechanism, and averaging two highly correlated profitability-improvement measures will most likely land between the parents rather than strengthen both metrics.

Same objection: it simply SUMRANKs the second legs of two archived issuance signals (Accrual-Funded Equity Supply and Equity-Funded Overhead Burden) behind the identical sstk/at multiplier, and the two "quality symptoms" are conceptually unrelated (accrual quality vs. cost structure), so pooling them mostly adds noise rather than isolating a common adverse issuer type.

Beyond being a close relative of the archived Cash-Matched Buyback and Fixed-Claim Cash Buffer, the bounded MIN/SUM matching ratio is internally inconsistent with the stated hypothesis: it is maximized when payouts exactly exhaust post-interest cash (zero retained buffer) and shrinks for firms whose cash flow greatly exceeds distributions, which is the opposite of "comfortably supportable payout."

The rigid-claims-times-cash-flow-volatility pairing is a coherent and not-yet-tested distress-fragility channel distinct from the archived level/persistence buffer signals, though it partly overlaps known distress and idiosyncratic-volatility effects and the xint+dvt aggregate awkwardly merges leverage (risk-increasing) with dividends (typically risk-reducing).

This is a template substitution of SG&A organizational capital for R&D in the archived Innovation Per-Share Conversion, but the conditioning construct is economically distinct (Eisfeldt–Papanikolaou-style intangible capital) and the sign logic is internally consistent, so it is worth one test while remaining derivative in construction.

A well-motivated conditional refinement that replaces the failed short-maturity-share proxy with the archive's strongest liquidity-gap measure, with sign direction correctly implied by the expression; the main risk is that the always-positive IND_RANK weight makes the signal largely a gap-weighted margin trend and may dilute the standalone gap's already strong evidence.
